notes:
BETA build - for testing.
- Fix: after you set a key or used Record, the update arrow and Check for updates... did nothing until the app was restarted.
- Checking for updates no longer pauses a macro that is running.
- Saving is faster and safe: a crash or power cut while saving can no longer lose your macros (the previous settings are kept as config\macros.ini.bak).
- Fix: installs where the app had been compiled into Macro Manager.exe (only when AutoHotkey with its compiler was installed on the PC) can now take updates.
